sentences.en: A tight belt will interfere with circulation of the blood.
sentences.zh: 一条紧的腰带会妨碍血液循环。

sentences.en: Those pants are a little too tight in the waist.
You should avoid tight fitting clothes if you are pregnant.
sentences.zh: 如果你怀孕了，应该避免穿紧身的衣服。

senses.zh: 紧的，牢固的；紧身的，贴身的；紧张的，绷紧的；（钱）紧缺的，不宽裕的；密集的，紧凑的；严格的，严密的
